title: Prime prevails in Beam dispute - Nature Biotechnology
text:
Prime Medicine has won a legal dispute with Beam Therapeutics over its gene-editing therapy for α1-antitrypsin deficiency (AATD), The decision gives Prime the go-ahead to launch a clinical trial with its AATD drug without owing monetary damages to Beam.The two biotechs, spun out of David Liu’s lab at Harvard University, are both developing next-generation, CRISPR-based gene-editing therapies for AATD, albeit with slightly different technologies. An agreement was set up in 2019 to define therapeutic fields and prevent direct competition between the two biotechs over mutation spaces.
